description: A test command captured with a quiet or silent flag, or with only framework noise and no runner stream, is not valid Gate 2B/3A/4A evidence even when exit_code is 0.
why_this_matters: Quiet flags hide the runner stream. Anti-pattern teaching text may contain `mvn -q`; this scenario checks the captured `command:` line and log body instead of banning that substring from the whole transcript.

input.user_prompt:
Build requirements/ECCS-12837/plan/plan.md
Go through it step by step and apply each step acceptance criteria in the agent loop.
input.context: A step or final test log under verification-logs/ starts with command: and exit_code: 0. The command line includes -q, --quiet, or --silent, and the body is only framework noise: no suite or test file name and no pass/fail/skip counts.

should_not_contain: implementationStatus COMPLETE with quiet-flag test log
